title: Edmund and the Vow
author: Emrys Eriksen
blurb: Oscar Blackwood, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
